title: VECTOR BREAKTHROUGH LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Vector Breakthrough will be open for a limited time. During the event, players can complete event stages to obtain Attainment Point, and increase the level of Breakthrough Milestones to obtain event rewards.
REWARDS: Achievement Star Collection - The Zoophilist and Her Mollusca for Vanilla, Event Icon, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Please refer to the official introduction for more details.

DETAILS: During the Orienteering Headhunting, you can select and lock in three 6-star and three 5-star Operators of this pool and raise their rates. The three selected 6-star Operators will be the only 6-star Operators in this headhunting.
★★★★★★(2%): Logos / Viviana / Hoederer / Ines / Ebenholz / Saileach
★★★★★(8%): Bassline / Spuria / Melanite / Corroserum / Cantabile / Paprika

◆ This is a Standard Headhunting. Once the rate-up Operators are selected, only the three selected 6-star Operators will appear in this pool, making up 100% of the 6-star Operators' pull rate. All 5-star Operators from the Standard Headhunting pool may appear, while the three selected 5-star Operators have a boosted rate, comprising 60% of the 5-star Operators' pull rate.
◆ For the duration of the current Orienteering Headhunting pool, the rate-up Operators cannot be changed.
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, Originite Prime * 9
CONTENTS: Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2

Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired 6-star Operator to Elite 2 Lv.1 (effective for 6-star Operators under Elite 2 Lv.1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
CONTENTS: Module Data Block * 24, Data Supplement Instrument * 30, Data Supplement Stick * 90

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive generous rewards, including: Professional Operator Training Invitation Letter (Use to level up a 4-star operator who has not yet been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 1), Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, etc.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, Professional Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1
Day 5: Furniture Part * 300, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 6: Module Data Block * 1, Pure Gold * 20
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
Please stay tuned for more information!
